r.문화권·종교: Sinhala and Tamil · mostly Buddhist, Hindu, Muslim, Christian
r.경제 체제: Market economy · tea, clothing, tourism, 2022 foreign debt crisis
r.주식시장 시가총액: $26.1 billion, 24% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)
r.생활 물가 수준: 27% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Clothing (knit) 23%, Coffee, tea, spices 14%, Clothing (woven) 14%, Rubber, tires 7%, Refined petroleum 4% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Refined petroleum 19%, Coated steel sheet 10%, Rubber, tires 9%, Machinery, computers 8% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Other clothing (knit) 12%, Other chemicals 11%, Other plant products 11%, Rubber, tires 10% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A 2022 economic crisis and protests forced the president out, and in 2024 a left-wing alliance that had never held power won elections.

t.why: Sitting in the middle of Indian Ocean shipping lanes, it has become a stage for India-China rivalry.
t.rel: An island country south of India, in the middle of Indian Ocean shipping lanes. Handing a port built with Chinese loans to a Chinese company for 99 years made it a stage for India-China rivalry.
t.know: It went through 26 years of civil war that ended in 2009.
t.etext: Tea, clothing, tourism and remittances are its main sources of foreign currency. In 2022 it ran out of foreign currency and defaulted on its debt, and it is recovering with IMF support.
